digest.component_or_area: codebase-wide refactoring: store paths, command lifecycle, engine reconciler, MCP
propositions: Multiple copies of the same decision (2–7 per hotspot) cause fixes to land incompletely: one copy gets patched while twins remain broken, creating three-ticket resolution families

Duplicated computations across sidecar keying, git adapter by-path loads, nested pytest, comment key/send, and compaction logic must be consolidated into single shared implementations with construct-uniqueness guards

Consolidation children must preserve all pinned observable behaviour (test assertions unchanged) and land with AST-based uniqueness guards that forbid silent second copies via explicit # <construct>-ok markers

The net-negative non-test line count criterion (AC3) is unachievable as specified: eight merged children measure +241 lines, not negative, because extraction adds documented owner modules faster than call-site shrinkage recovers

Test-only-additions criterion (AC2) is unsatisfiable for consolidation work that removes duplicated test helpers and re-points assertions at surviving owners; nine of 23 children legitimately violate the proxy
